name: Retention and lifecycle marketer
summary: Brings customers back to buy again with email and SMS flows, subscriptions and loyalty perks. Measures repeat purchase and fixes the points where customers drift away.

changelog.note: First release: repeat-purchase and cohort reads, holdout testing, SMS consent and sending rules for the US (TCPA, carriers), UK (PECR) and EU (GDPR, national rules), subscription and cancel-path rules, false-urgency limits, Klaviyo benchmarks with caveats, three skills, five prompts, two workflows and training material, with 30 checked sources.
Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name.
